phases.name: Prove the lock/resume blank state is a local-hydration race.
Add a protected, scope-keyed Analytics presentation snapshot.
Restore only for the unscoped Analytics overview.
Preserve valid snapshots from partial/empty refreshes.
Distinguish initial loading from a real empty scope.
Add unit coverage and install a signed physical-device build without deleting data.
Confirm the next manual lock → unlock after Analytics has created its first snapshot.
